sources.name: DexMimicGen

sources.name: IQL
sources.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Q-Learning
sources.setting: 固定数据 offline RL，另有 offline-to-online 实验

sources.use: 固定经验可用于价值学习与优势加权；原文指出其 Adroit / Kitchen 中多数 RL 方法与模仿学习接近。
sources.limitation: 表 3 是归一化回报，不是成功率；不证明现代视觉 π0.5 在灵巧手上的 RL 增益。

sources.name: DAPG
sources.title: Learning Complex Dexterous Manipulation with Deep Reinforcement Learning and Demonstrations
sources.setting: BC 初始化 + 示范辅助的在线策略梯度

sources.use: 示范可以帮助在线 RL 降低样本需求；是先模仿再交互优化的直接灵巧手证据。
sources.limitation: 论文以仿真为主；等效机器人小时不等于真实硬件训练小时；不是 flow VLA 方法。

research_focus: Jointly improve multiple skills in one pretrained generalist VLA under limited data/interaction and compute budgets; report gains, coverage, regressions and costs.
long_horizon_role: Illustrative deployment motivation and optional application evaluation; not the core skill-handoff optimization objective.
suggested_diagnostic: Test heterogeneous learning signals under uniform task sampling before choosing adaptive task allocation, gradient correction or parameter isolation.
regime_question: When is supervised finetuning sufficient for multi-skill manipulation, and when do offline or online RL provide measurable value under matched data and cost accounting?
